# Phase 13 — Integration, E2E, and Early-Access Readiness

Follow Copilot instructions. Validate integration across request API, persistence, identity, policy, runtime, tools, model adapter, approvals, evidence and observability. Add contract/integration/E2E tests for critical journeys, failure/cancel/approval paths, clean migrations, graceful shutdown and recovery. Verify CI workflows, reproducible build, deployment manifests only if approved, operational runbooks and release checklist. Do not deploy or merge automatically. Produce an evidence-backed readiness report listing checks, exact results, unresolved blockers, security residual risks, rollback/operational notes and criteria status. Acceptance: all required gates green and no unresolved blocker without documented owner/approval.
